items.name: header-content-footer
items.title: Header / Content / Footer
items.description: The page chassis: chrome that stays, a body that scrolls, floors that let it. Ships the sticky preset alongside the base.

items.name: card-layout
items.title: Card Layout
items.description: A card with its slots already placed: icon, title, description, header action, body, and a footer split between prose and buttons.

items.name: dialog-layout
items.title: Dialog Layout
items.description: A dialog whose body scrolls under a header that does not. Composes the header/content/footer chassis rather than owning a second copy.

items.name: form-field
items.title: Form Field
items.description: One field: a label wired to its control, a description, an error the control is described by, and a skeleton the right height for what is loading. Presentational — it binds to no form library.

items.name: form-dialog
items.title: Form Dialog
items.description: A form in a dialog: one form element, a submit the keyboard reaches, a guard against saving twice, and a place for the form-level error. Composes the dialog shell rather than re-deriving it.

items.name: layout
items.title: Layout Set
items.description: Every cubeui layout shell in one install.

items.name: skill
items.title: cubeui Agent Skill
items.description: How to use these components, for agents working in a consuming project. Installs into .claude/skills/.
